sections.text: Introduction

The LFAA auto Re-closer relay provides facilities for 
single or two-shot enclosures of one or two circuit breakers following their 
tripping for a fault on an overhead line. The enclosures can be selected to be 
either high speed single-phase or high speed or delayed three-phase. When 
three-phase enclosure is desired the equipment will convert any single or 
two-phase tripping into three-phase tripping before initiating the enclosure For 
schemes with two circuit breakers the enclosure of the second circuit breaker 
can be either simultaneous with the first circuit breaker or it can be 
sequential. In the latter case the enclosure of the second circuit breaker must 
naturally be a delayed three phase enclosure. Different operating cycles can be 
selected using the keypad on the relay front-plate.

These allow the relay to 
perform various combinations of the following cycles:

One breaker schemes (LFAA 
101) Single shot scheme:- single phase auto-recluse- single phase or three phase 
- auto recluse, depending on type 
of fault- 
three phase auto-recluse for all types of fault two shot scheme: any of the 
above cycles for the first shot, followed by delayed phase auto-recluse if 
protection re-operates during the reclaim time after the first recluse Two 
breaker schemes (LFAA 102) Combinations of single and three phase auto-recluse as 
above circuit breakers can be closed simultaneously or sequentially on the first

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Relays Preparation
Review the manual and drawings.
Prepare the previous or commissioning results of the relay testing.
Check the wires of the relay by hand.
Check the AC source is available to the tester.
Check the existence of the DC sources in panels.

Disconnect the trip leads of the relay and connect one of them to the 
timer of the tester.
Check all the leads used in tests.

sections.text: Test Steps

Connect the current and voltage leads of a tester unit to the relay 
points according to the drawings and scheme.

Obtain copy of 
relay's setting specification from field maintenance file.

Look at field 
maintenance file and compare the data in liquid crystal display LCD of relay by 
show the operational parameters and setting with setting sheet 
and data. 
.

Check that the 
cables are in good condition and that all wire connections are tight and 
clean.

Block 
protection signals to: Breaker trip coils and transfer trip scheme's

Block any 
disturbance alarms or fault recorders associated with this protection.

Go to the 
switchgear and inspect the CT's, the VT miniature circuit breakers (MCB's), and 
all cabling supplying the relay:

Perform 
function test on relay scheme to ensure all associated auxiliary relays are 
working properly.

Test 
recluse all breakers associated with this device scheme.

Repeat the steps for each point according to the 
test sheet.
Record the results.

Verify the 
test results match the relay setting specifications previously obtained 
from field maintenance rile. If not consult 
Technical Services/Central protection

sections.text: Trip Test
Request the operator to switch on the main circuit breaker.

Operate the output auxiliary contact of distance relay by injection 
 to trip the circuit breaker.

Check that the circuit breaker tripped 
 and reclosed.
